items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: Oh, I stayed with Ecc for a long time... So the band, Echols band kind of split... But I went with Earl Dancer.

ctx.x: Well who was in the Charlie Echols band?

Well that you would know, I don't think, they were all local boys and I doubt if whether any of them ever left California. I don't think any of them ever left. They were all local. It was a pretty good band. It was a good hard swinging band.

Echols was a trumpet player that never knew one note from another, but he would just act like he was playing and whatever came out of this horn it didn't disagree too much with the band but he wasn't playing anything really.
